User wants healthcare services nearby for an autonomous senior day center (CDIA). 'Nearby' maps to the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.
Energy class D or better, as explicitly requested for the office building to be converted into a CDIA. Covers all classes from A1 to D.
